environment.description: FastAPI service on ECS Fargate behind AWS ALB with mutual TLS listener (port 443). The ALB is configured with a trust store referencing an internal CA bundle (arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:trust-store/ts-internal-0a1b2c3d). The listener's mutual authentication mode is set to 'verify' (not 'passthrough'), meaning the ALB terminates mTLS and only forwards requests where the client presented a valid certificate signed by the trust store CA. The X-Client-Cert-Fingerprint header is stripped and re-injected by the ALB from the verified certificate. Additionally, the ALB's connection idle timeout is 30s and the trust store has a CRL configured. The service's security group only allows ingress from the ALB's security group (sg-0abc123def456). Note: the null dereference still exists in code but the race window between session creation and metadata enrichment is <50ms in this environment due to the sidecar enrichment container in the same task definition.
